searchText: Should we expect ELs to serve `eth` endpoints via the JWT-authenticated RPC? The engine API is supposed to include the `eth` namespace. There's some talk of specifically listing the APIs but last I saw it still just said the whole namespace. And the idea was to list whatever APIs were useful - the aim is to be explicit about what's available, not specifically to reduce the scope. Here we go with the list, https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/183 All these methods must be exposed at auth endpoint as well Fully verified ancestor is influenced by optimistic blocks applied to the fork choice. It might be dangerous in some edge cases to attest to these blocks, even though they are fully verified hi, i sucessfully deposited to Kintsugi ~4h ago and the validator is still "not found" in the explorer: https://beaconchain.kintsugi.themerge.dev/validator/aed9739891f11e8e62da3becef00e3f8be020facd47389fd6699fba6d24a053bbbdc0ebc6dbc79d3045e9790c79903b5 how else can i debug whether the deposit is at least valid?
